name: SelectCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Select Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Selects a specific range of cells in the given Excel worksheet or workbook.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the cell selection will be performed.

fields.name: SelectionMode
fields.label: Selection Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to select the cells.

selectOptions.label: Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Selects a named range of cells.

selectOptions.label: Range of Cells
selectOptions.description: Selects a specific range of cells (e.g., 'A1:B10').

selectOptions.label: Relative to Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Selects a range relative to the active cell.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to select (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Named Cells').

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to select (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to select (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to select (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to select (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Range of Cells').

fields.name: XAxisDirection
fields.label: X-Axis Direction
fields.description: Specifies the direction along the X-axis for relative selection (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Relative to Active Cell').

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Moves left from the active cell.

selectOptions.label: Right
selectOptions.description: Moves right from the active cell.

fields.name: YAxisDirection
fields.label: Y-Axis Direction
fields.description: Specifies the direction along the Y-axis for relative selection (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Relative to Active Cell').

fields.name: XOffset
fields.label: X Offset
fields.description: The number of columns to offset from the active cell (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Relative to Active Cell').

fields.name: YOffset
fields.label: Y Offset
fields.description: The number of rows to offset from the active cell (required if 'Selection Mode' is 'Relative to Active Cell').
